# Neuro & Evil Karaoke API — Playlists

Base URL: https://api.neurokaraoke.com (Production)

Public user-created playlists and the featured playlists shown on the home page.

### `GET /api/playlist/{id}` — Get a playlist

Auth: none

Returns a playlist and its songs. Applies to public playlists, setlists and the caller's own playlists.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | `string` | yes |  |

Response `200` OK `application/json`:

```ts
{
  id: string | null
  name: string | null
  description: string | null
  createdBy: string | null
  updatedBy: string | null
  media: {
    id: string | null
    fileName: string | null
    contentType: string | null
    description: string | null
    isAnimated: bool
    credit: string | null
    cloudflareId: string | null
    mediaStorageType: int  // Possible values: `0` = Blob, `1` = Cloudflare, `2` = Badge
    absolutePath: string | null
    artist: {
      id: string | null
      name: string | null
      socialLink: string | null
      userId: string | null
      arts: object[] | null
    }
    upvotes: int
    tagString: string | null
    mediaTag: int  // Possible values: `0` = Neuro, `1` = Evil, `2` = Twins, `3` = Hiyori
  }
  createdAt: date-time | null
  updatedAt: date-time | null
  totalDuration: int | null
  songCount: int | null
  playCount: int | null
  favoriteCount: int | null
  playlistType: int  // Possible values: `0` = Setlist, `1` = Public, `2` = Private, `3` = Featured
  songListDTOs: {
    id: string | null
    title: string | null
    opus: string | null
    oss: string | null
    cnPath: string | null
    absolutePath: string | null
    playCount: int | null
    duration: int | null
    streamDate: date-time | null
    dateAdded: date-time | null
    coverArtists: string[] | null
    originalArtists: string[] | null
    genres: string[] | null
    coverArt: { …same as `media` above }
    thumbnailArt: { …same as `media` above }
    order: int
    hasLyrics: bool
    userUploaded: bool
    videoId: string | null
    hls: string | null
  }[] | null
  mosaicMedia: { …same as `media` above }[] | null
  genres: string[] | null
  editable: bool
  deletable: bool
  isPublic: bool
  isSetList: bool
  setListDate: date-time | null
}
```

### `GET /api/playlist/public` — List public playlists

Auth: none

Returns public playlists. Supports paging (`startIndex`, `pageSize`), `search`, sorting (`sortBy`, `sortDescending`), `year`, and `genreIds` as a comma-separated list.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `startIndex` | query | `int` | no | default: 0 |
| `pageSize` | query | `int` | no | default: 30 |
| `search` | query | `string` | no |  |
| `sortBy` | query | `string` | no |  |
| `sortDescending` | query | `bool` | no | default: false |
| `year` | query | `int` | no | default: 0 |
| `genreIds` | query | `string` | no |  |

Response `200` OK `application/json`:

### `GET /api/playlist/public/genres` — List playlist genres

Auth: none

Returns the genres available for filtering public playlists.

Response `200` OK `application/json`:

```ts
{
  id: string | null
  name: string | null
  songCount: int
}[]
```
